# endpointcentral_mac_custom_profile (Resource)

A macOS profile built from a `.mobileconfig`, managed through the MDM API (`mdm.manageengine.<region>`). Assign it to MDM groups with `endpointcentral_mdm_group_profile_assignment`; this resource never assigns it anywhere by itself.

Everything changes in place. A new `content` is uploaded and published as the next version of the same profile, which is pushed to the groups it is assigned to, so the profile is replaced on the Macs rather than removed and added. The API cannot return a profile's content, so changes made to it in the console are not detected; renames and description changes are.

Needs the `MDMOnDemand.MDMDeviceMgmt.*` scopes. Endpoint Central's own calls for Mac custom profile *configurations* only accept a browser session, which is why this uses the MDM API (see DESIGN.md).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A profile kept in Git.
resource "endpointcentral_mac_custom_profile" "screensaver" {
  name    = "Screen saver"
  content = file("${path.module}/profiles/screensaver.mobileconfig")
}

# A generated profile: when a value changes, the new profile is published as
# the next version of the same profile and pushed to the Macs in one apply.
variable "wifi_password" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

resource "endpointcentral_mac_custom_profile" "wifi" {
  name = "Office Wi-Fi"
  content = templatefile("${path.module}/templates/wifi.mobileconfig.tftpl", {
    ssid     = "Office"
    password = var.wifi_password
  })
}

# Profiles reach Macs through MDM groups.
resource "endpointcentral_mdm_group" "engineering" {
  name = "engineering-macs"
}

resource "endpointcentral_mdm_group_profile_assignment" "screensaver" {
  group_id   = endpointcentral_mdm_group.engineering.id
  profile_id = endpointcentral_mac_custom_profile.screensaver.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `content` (String, Sensitive) The `.mobileconfig` itself, e.g. `file("profiles/macos/baseline.mobileconfig")` or a `templatefile(...)`. Sensitive, because profiles can carry secrets such as passwords or tokens; it is still stored in the state, so keep the state encrypted.
- `name` (String) Profile name. Unique among MDM profiles.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Profile description.
- `file_name` (String) File name the profile is uploaded under. Defaults to the name with `.mobileconfig`.

### Read-Only

- `content_sha256` (String) SHA-256 of `content`, so a plan shows when the profile changes without showing the profile.
- `id` (String) Profile ID.
- `status` (String) Status as reported by the MDM API, e.g. `Published`.
- `version` (Number) Published version; it goes up with every content change.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The MDM profile ID. The content cannot be read back, so the first apply
# after an import publishes the configured content once.
tofu import endpointcentral_mac_custom_profile.engineering 200000000133026
```
